<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShopPurchase" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Purchase items from an online shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_User">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseReward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPaymentMethod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallmentAgreement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReturnChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Order process starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Login" name="Log in to account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Select items and set payment method" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose one of multiple free reward options"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentChoice" name="Choose payment option" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallmentAgreement" name="Complete installment agreement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Merge payment options" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Wait for reward choice and payment" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryMerge" name="Merge initial and repeat delivery paths" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveDelivery" name="Receive delivery"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnChoice" name="Return items for exchange?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Order complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_Split" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Select" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Reward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reward_Join" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPayment_Choice" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Pay" name="Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Installment" name="Complete installment agreement" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Installment_Merge" sourceRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryMerge_Receive" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_ReturnChoice" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDelivery" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnChoice_Return" name="Return items" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnChoice_End" name="Do not return items" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
